feature_contract.goal: Restore original-game ESC pause shell and exact arrows/YES-NO to one head-forward optical vertical centre across asymmetric up/down eye FOV, responsive scale and signed vertical offset, without altering world, HUD, F11 or other game states.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R30 original-game pause screen-element classification and all three XYZRHW paired/fallback plus shader HUD draw routes; no host menu/front-end, world, DX11, DXVK or FFB changes.
trace_stages: Original paused game queues ScreenOverlay2D menu shell and exact ScreenHud arrow/YES-NO tags.
R30 identifies only true STATE_SMPAUSEMENU elements, latches both XR eyes FOV and derives a shared forward-centred vertical affine.
R30 paired-eye XYZRHW, independent conservative XYZRHW and shader WVP apply matched per-eye vertical scale/offset and preserve distinct configurable downward shift.
subcomponents: Model both up/down FOV intervals in head-forward tangent space, fail neutral if either invalid or out of bounds.
Apply exactly the same vertical optical map to ESC shell and exact arrow tags in all R30 render paths; leave foreign semantics unchanged.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both eye image centres converge to forward ray with original pause shell and exact arrows applying scale/vertical offset on all three draw paths.

Invalid one-eye FOV falls back neutral bilaterally, desktop symmetric case unchanged; F11, generic game HUD, GOAL, world/SkyGlow never enter this pause-only map; negative mutation rejects a missing eye.
Exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy/host/game/full-chain/package and Domain Isolation, Full Source Impact as applicable all succeed; Quest3 remains separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30 original paused-game UI uses common Y containment and user offset, unlike X it omitted actual per-eye asymmetric up/down OpenXR FOV. Existing ESC geometry is miscentred in asymmetric headset projection even when 2D shell/arrow classification and menu scale match.
diagnosis.root_cause: Vertical eye FOV asymmetry has no equivalent of R30BuildEyeAffine's horizontal tangent map in three R30 paused UI submission routes.
alternatives_rejected: Do not impose a global Y bias that would move protected gameplay HUD, F11 or world.
Do not modify R23 4:3 main menu: 00788 already owns that feature.
Do not infer binocular pass from a Windows build without Quest3/VDXR.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Pure C++ asymmetric/symmetric/one-eye-invalid/inverted/extreme eye FOV smoke and source destructive checks for three R30 paths and F11 exclusion.
